body: The Cosmetic Surgery Field Guide is for the patient weighing a procedure abroad — whether a quote made your stomach drop or a transformation reel made it speed up.

It is not a ranking of clinics or surgeons, and it accepts no payment from them. It teaches you to verify the surgeon's register and the facility, decode the quote, resist influencer urgency, and recognize the documented patient-harm patterns this book takes editorial positions on.

Built around the Five Rules, the Seven Leverage Points, and a 20-Minute Safety Pause — with 12 scenarios, word-for-word scripts, green/yellow/red checklists, and 18 reusable worksheets. Re-researched and updated every year.
